Recognize the approach

Synthwave looks back at imagined electronic futures, borrowing from 1980s media and later music culture.

Look for

  • Neon accents on dark grounds
  • Perspective grids and glowing horizons
  • Retro display lettering

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Synthwave looks back at imagined electronic futures, borrowing from 1980s media and later music culture. It is a revival aesthetic, not a faithful copy of what every 1980s interface looked like.

Period or influence
2000s onward; 1980s references
What this label describes
Music-linked retro aesthetic

Dates describe broad influences or visibility. Styles overlap and return; this is not a sequence of replacements.

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Draw a perspective grid in SVG and use a small number of glow layers.
  2. Create the horizon and lettering as separate assets. Keep functional text bright and free of heavy blur.

Small practice task

Create a horizon graphic with a grid and one light source. Make a readable navigation treatment beside it.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
